title: Billing workspace
note: Persistent order, clear category navigation and a fixed payment action.

title: Start a new bill
note: Empty state explains the next action without hiding menu selection.

title: Ongoing orders
note: Queue states use text labels, elapsed time and direct resume actions.

title: Tables & floor plan
note: Table occupancy, amount and service state stay visible together.

title: Held bills
note: Parked bills have a named owner and can be resumed or discarded explicitly.

title: Item modifiers
note: Required choices precede optional add-ons. Price changes remain visible.

title: Edit an order line
note: Edit quantity and notes; kitchen-sent items require a separate correction.

title: Find / attach customer
note: Search by name or phone; adding a customer is secondary.

title: Add customer
note: Only the essential fields lead; consent is explicit and unchecked.

title: Assign a table
note: Available and occupied tables are visibly different.

title: Order details & service
note: Service mode, staff, price mode and order details are one coherent panel.

title: Apply bill discount
note: Scope, amount and effective discount are visible before applying.

title: Apply coupon
note: Eligibility and reason for unavailable offers are explicit.

title: Charges & tax breakdown
note: Show configured tax and charges without silent recalculation.

title: Order note
note: Receipt notes and kitchen instructions have distinct visibility.

title: Hold this bill
note: A meaningful label makes the parked bill easy to retrieve.

title: Send to kitchen
note: New items route to named stations; existing kitchen tickets are not resent.

title: Split a bill by items
note: Item splitting creates separate bills; it is distinct from multiple tenders.

title: Move / merge table
note: Preview destination and source before moving or combining orders.

title: Cash payment
note: Cash tender, quick amounts and change are readable at a glance.

title: UPI payment
note: Reference is deliberately non-payable; live status must come from the provider.

title: Card payment
note: Do not collect card data in the POS; use the configured terminal.

title: Split tender
note: Each tender has its own amount and status; balance remains visible.

title: Credit / Udhar
note: Require a customer and show limit, outstanding balance and due date.

title: Payment complete
note: Payment success and receipt delivery are separate statuses.

title: Payment status unknown
note: Keep the bill locked while checking; prevent an accidental second charge.

title: Payment failed
note: Only a confirmed failure exposes retry or an alternative method.

title: Receipt print failed
note: A print failure never changes the successful payment state.

title: Void bill / cancel order
note: Show affected bill, kitchen state, mandatory reason and approval requirement.

title: Manager approval
note: Approval names the exact action and does not elevate the entire session.

title: Return / refund
note: Select original items, reason and refund route; preserve receipt history.

title: Offline billing
note: Separate local availability, sync queue and unavailable online methods.

title: Keyboard shortcuts
note: Explicit shortcuts, focus handling and no global Enter-to-pay.

title: Sales history
note: Compact filterable ledger with a clear detail action per receipt.

title: Receipt & payment detail
note: Keep tender, receipt, refunds and activity tied to one transaction.

title: Day close & cash count
note: Counted cash, expected cash and variance are separate; closure is explicit.

title: Cash in / cash out
note: Record a reason and tender movement without mixing it with sales.

title: Customers
note: Readable customer ledger, outstanding balance and direct context.

title: Customer profile & ledger
note: Balance and recent transactions sit together; consent is visible.

title: Credit outstanding
note: Aging and due dates guide collection; reminders remain explicit.

title: Receive credit payment
note: Allocate received money to an identified outstanding balance.

title: Items & inventory
note: Stock, availability and price are scannable; changes open an editor.

title: Item / variant editor
note: Organize price, inventory, modifiers and kitchen routing into groups.

title: Reports & exports
note: Separate report selection from the detailed operational billing view.

title: Business overview
note: A restrained summary with operational links; no dashboard clutter in billing.

title: Expense ledger
note: Date, category, payment method and status form a compact ledger.

title: Add expense
note: Required amount, category and method; optional supporting detail.

title: Suppliers & payables
note: Outstanding amount and due status anchor the supplier ledger.

title: Pay supplier
note: Record payment against invoices and show the remaining payable.

title: Greetings & reminders
note: Preview recipient, template and consent before each manual send.

title: Settings home
note: Group billing, printing, people and store configuration.

title: Printers & kitchen routing
note: Receipt, default KOT and station printers are separate assignments.

title: Receipt / KOT layout
note: Live sample preview and explicit paper size beside grouped toggles.

title: Detailed A4 / A5 invoice
note: Keep detailed invoice choices distinct from thermal receipt settings.

title: Staff & permissions
note: Role, status and privileges; discount and void limits stay visible.

title: Add staff member
note: Role-scoped permissions and PIN setup in one bounded form.

title: Coupons & offers
note: Show offer value, validity and eligibility with distinct statuses.

title: Create a coupon
note: Name, type, validity and limits; preview the customer-facing offer.

title: QR ordering
note: Payment timing and menu publication are separate configuration steps.

title: Order & invoice numbering
note: Preview the next number and explain reset cadence.

title: Tax & rounding
note: Configuration reference only; rates require business validation.

title: Billing screen preferences
note: One clean list of tools with role-specific visibility guidance.

title: Business profile & devices
note: Account, plan, connected devices and data actions are clearly grouped.

title: Staff lock screen
note: Lock hides transaction details and preserves the active bill.

title: Takeaway billing
note: Pickup reference replaces the table. Bill and payment positions stay fixed.

title: Delivery billing
note: Delivery contact and address replace dine-in context.

title: Delivery / pickup details
note: Keep recipient, address and delivery instructions separate from kitchen notes.

title: Choose a printer
note: Show connection, paper width and readiness before assignment.

title: Kitchen ticket not sent
note: Preserve the failed ticket and station; receipt printers are never a KOT fallback.

title: Approve a larger discount
note: Approval identifies the bill, amount, percentage, reason and new total.

title: Review day closure
note: A final review keeps unresolved orders visible and blocks premature closure.

title: Discard a held draft
note: Only unsent, unpaid drafts can be discarded; kitchen-sent orders use void instead.
